title: Do you have material about the beginnings of the art movement?
intro: Photographs, press clippings, catalogues, invitations, certificates, recordings. It doesn't need to be complete or in order — the documentation team handles inspection and numbering.
name: Name
contactPlaceholder: So we can reach you about the material
rolePlaceholder: Artist · artist's family · association · private collection · researcher
cityPlaceholder: The city where the material is
descriptionPlaceholder: Roughly what kind, how many items, and what period do they cover?
dropTitle: Drag files here or choose them
dropHint: JPG · TIFF · PDF · MP3 — up to 2 GB per submission
attestation: I confirm that I own this material or am authorized to submit it, and I understand that nothing is published before an authorization letter is signed.

review.title: Initial review
review.body: The documentation team contacts you within a week to confirm what we received and what is missing.

catalog.title: Inspection and numbering
catalog.body: The material is inspected and digitized in high quality, and each item is given an identification code.

authorization.title: Signed authorization
authorization.body: You decide the access level: fully available, preview only, or by research request.

publish.title: Publication
publish.body: The material appears in the archive under your name or your group's name, and can be amended later.

errors.type: “{name}” is not a supported file type. Use JPG, TIFF, PDF or MP3.
errors.size: Adding “{name}” would go over the 2 GB limit for one submission.
errors.invalid: Please check the form and try again.
errors.throttled: You have sent several submissions in a short time. Please try again in an hour.

confirmationTitle: Thank you. We have your submission.
confirmationBody: Nothing you sent is public. The documentation team will contact you using the details you gave, and nothing is published without your signed authorization.
